font_contract.source_faces: exact bundled Latin WOFF2 subsets used by the updated HTML
font_contract.native_source_of_truth: committed TTF bytes derived once from those exact bundled faces
font_contract.build_policy: no WOFF2-to-TTF converter or regeneration step in normal build/test
font_contract.reason: pixel provenance is tied to the bundled faces; arbitrary upstream full TTF releases are not accepted as equivalent parity baselines

updated_inline_vector_catalog.normalization: extract each inline <svg> block from decoded template, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, sort unique exact blocks; for path catalog extract d attributes, collapse whitespace, sort unique values
updated_inline_vector_catalog.rule: export exact updated-source geometry/strokes once; no runtime SVG and no generic icon/emoji fallback

unit_glyph_masks.rendering: White alpha masks derived from source glyph() polygons and source D.* or static Back paths; ImageNode.color applies semantic tint. Original source atlas slots 0..50 are preserved pixel-for-pixel. Task 6 adds the source icon() masks for HP plus, Hangar Mobility cross+top arrow, Ending Mobility cross, Weapon lightning, and purchase currency hex in slots 63..67.
unit_glyph_masks.source_provenance: Updated source template glyph() at template 1172, D/icon paths at template 1195-1206, static Back path at template 558, and Task 6 dynamic track paths at template 1395-1417 and 1492-1503

board_geometry_atlas.state_rule: tile parity, move/attack highlights, telegraphs, selection and inspection reuse geometry through ImageNode.color/theme constants; source-distinct hazard/explosive/extraction symbols use the UI icon atlas/native overlays
board_geometry_atlas.rect_table: const Rust data in src/presentation/theme.rs; not parsed from JSON

battle_geometry.depth_mechanism: flat sibling stage list using Bevy ZIndex; blocker=10+depth*3; token=11+depth*3
battle_geometry.input: marker-required Bevy UI picking; one stage node uses normalized HitData.position -> stage-local px -> inverse isometric projection + diamond inclusion; Pointer<Move> drives hover; token cards route current GridPos
battle_geometry.canvas_scale: CanvasLayout::fit is pure geometry; runtime fixed-pixel scaling uses Bevy UiScale and a centered CanvasRoot; to_design is capture/diagnostic only
battle_geometry.menu: new MenuState drives fixed left 352px sidebar; no board anchoring and no clamp_menu

snapshot_reuse.objective: extend existing ObjectiveTrackSnapshot in src/presentation/ui.rs; do not add PrimaryProgressSnapshot synonym
snapshot_reuse.threat: extend existing ThreatSnapshot; cells becomes Vec<GridPos>; do not add a second threat type
snapshot_reuse.campaign: replace briefing_copy/upgrade_row_copy/ending_copy call sites in place with typed returns
snapshot_reuse.log: RecentBattleLog calls existing ui::format_event once per dequeued event

capture_fixture_contract.implementation: typed Rust const table in examples/ui_capture/fixtures.rs
capture_fixture_contract.rule: use real MissionId/UnitId/GameScreen/CampaignUiAction/CommandAction/GridPos and other closed Rust types; JSON does not contain executable action/fact strings
capture_fixture_contract.synthetic_rule: use BattleState::new or an existing typed test fixture only when authored content cannot produce the renderer contract; never invent MissionId

window_checks.hidpi: stage-local pointer alignment test using UI HitData.position; add a PNG only if a renderer-specific discrepancy is found

camera_contract.rule: campaign and battle cameras are explicitly marked/owned and carry UiPickingCamera; cleanup never queries bare Camera2d
camera_contract.capture: example-only examples/ui_capture.rs with test=false; no src/presentation/capture.rs library module
